name: Woodlawn Campground
evidence: satellite at 38.45106,-75.56138 (leaf-off Esri, 700 m and 400 m frames): the parcel is the wooded block just west of US-13 and no water body of any kind is visible on or adjacent to it - no pond, creek or shoreline - despite bare canopy; the operator's own site places fishing in ponds and rivers NEARBY rather than on site, and an aggregator's 'beach area' is uncorroborated -> not waterfront.

name: Sleepy Hollow Campground
evidence: satellite at all THREE candidate pins for this campground (Census 39.63739,-79.10673; RV Life 39.63805,-79.11457; Campspot 39.640869,-79.124367, spanning 1.7 km): unbroken Garrett County forest and cleared field at each, with no lake, pond or creek adjacent to any of them - so not waterfront holds regardless of which pin is right. Operator and Campspot both place the water (New Germany Lake, swimming, boat rentals) in the state park under a mile away rather than at the campground.
